answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a slashable registration bond. An agent must post collateral before its attestations count, and seats are drawn without replacement from a shared pool, so one operator running thousands of fake identities must fund thousands of separate bonds instead of one. When timing or voting correlation flags an island of linked accounts, the protocol burns the tundra of collateral behind every member at once. Marginal attacker cost scales with each fake agent while reward per fake stays flat, so a lone honest bonded oasis outearns any farm per unit of capital.
